title: Count song pairs with a 60-bucket frequency array
invariant: Before processing index i, counts[r] is the number of songs at indices below i whose duration has remainder r modulo 60. Query the complementary bucket before recording the current song, so each valid pair is counted once.

frames.explanation: The 60 frequency buckets start at zero. Each bucket will count only songs at earlier indices.

scene.description: Before scanning, every frequency is zero.

frames.explanation: Index 0: 30 leaves remainder 30. Its complementary remainder is 30; 0 earlier song(s) are in that bucket.

scene.description: Song 0 checks earlier songs in remainder bucket 30; 0 match.

frames.explanation: Add 0 earlier match(es). The running answer is 0; the current song is still absent from the frequency array.

scene.description: The 0 earlier matches raise the answer to 0; the current song is not stored yet.

frames.explanation: Record index 0 in remainder bucket 30. Later songs can now pair with it.

scene.description: Song 0 is now recorded in remainder bucket 30, which contains 1 song(s).
